value.text: {"claims":[{"quote":"Over the past week, two Amazon delivery service partner owners I talk to regularly (one in the Southeast, one in the Mid-Atlantic, both with 40-plus vans) independently said their Amazon station managers have told them to plan for fewer peak-season routes than last year.
